Unexpected ... delicious
Feb 2026 • Couples
When walking by we saw the food looked good, so gave it a try. Although the menu's were not in English, with some help of the waitress we ordered some crab dishes that she thought Europeans would like (as most of the menu showed very exotic seafood options .. no idea if we would like those)
We got crab springrolls, a crab salad and fried rice with crab. It looked good and tasted very nice. Fresh ingredients, vegetables, herbs were used and well prepared.
The price vs quality is fine. Recommended!!

Local, tasty and bring your sign language skills
Jul 2017 • Family
This is definitely a place with few to none foreigners around you. The staff although really friendly had very limited English skills, we ordered by pointing at the menu (most dishes had pictures).
Although dedicated to crabs a wide variety of seafood is is available. They do have water tanks where you can chose your own catch, if you like that.
Food was very tasty, no holding back on the flavors to cater for an international crowd. Good value for money with food and a couple of drinks for 2 adults and 3 kids going for 500.000 Dong (approx 50$).

On TripAdvisor this is named Ut Ca Mau restaurant. We're still learning the Vietnamese way so that might totally correct, however if you look for the place they also had the name Vửa Cua Cà Mau outside (along with Ut Ca Mau). See attached pictures for guidance.

Eat with locals
Jul 2017 • Couples
Wanting to immerse ourselves with local, fresh food we stepped out of the western hotel and ventured out to find some fresh food. Once we stepped across bust nightlife traffic we noticed the live crabs in tanks and figured this has to be safe as it was fresh (crabs were still moving ). As an Aussie couple we were the only non locals as we realized this is the local place on a Friday night. It was just what we wanted ie. Vietnamese way of life! Short plastic chairs and tables but it was fun! Great view of city night streets from balcony and Cheap beer and food was fresh , steaming hot and for our first night in Ho Chi Minh I had the best crab spring rolls ever 👍would recommend this especially if you are staying at hotel equatorial down the road.

If you love crab you gotta try the BBQ crabs here.
Apr 2017 • Friends
If you love BBQ crabs, you gotta try this place. They served double shell crabs filled with roe. ( You have to specify or they will serve you meat crabs - no roe) We had Vietnamese hot pot too, but I would have rather had a Tom Yam based soup or plain broth as the soup was too sweet. 
Getting there, that evening was a challenge due to the traffic and the fact that Tien Bien Phu Street in District 10. I took a Grab taxi but unfortunately gave the wrong address number. Fortunately, I was able to call the friend I was meeting to talk to the driver. It was due to this that a 15 minute trip took 90 minutes also due to the traffic congestion. 
Anyway the food was worth the stress getting there.
Four tips travelling in Ho Chin Minh if you do not speak Vietnamese.
 1. Get a Vietnamese Data SIM card for your phone or mobile wifi. 
2. Get the routing from Google map and use this to check your route to destination
 3. Have your hotel calling card to find your way back by showing to the driver and standby if you need their help to advise the driver. 
4. Install WhatsApp or Viber and make sure the hotel has a contact number with these apps. However, if you have credit in Viber Out it helps because you will be able to call the local number.

Seriously local
May 2017 • Couples
When in Vietnam do as the Vietnamese do. 
This is a seriously local restaurant. NO ONE speaks English. Luckily there are photos on the menu so you just point and order.
Very good prices and the food is good as well. 

We tried some local food like chicken feet and fully fried fish. A little bit spice but definitely worth trying. 

Nothing fancy. You sit on little plastic chairs with the locals. 

If you don't want to sit uncomfortable or want to speak English or want to know what it is that you are eating then this isn't the place for you.

But if you want to give a couple of hours of your comfy time to try something weird and different, this is a must! 

I kinda love it.
